title: authoring-ui tsc error: _getFrameClipboard/_setFrameClipboard not declared in JsflDocument interface
description:
packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts line 3990 adds _getFrameClipboard() and _setFrameClipboard() to the document proxy object literal, but these methods are NOT declared in the JsflDocument interface (defined at line 1696).

Confirmed via cd packages/authoring-ui && npx tsc --noEmit:
  src/jsfl/runtime.ts(3990,5): error TS2353: Object literal may only specify known properties, and '_getFrameClipboard' does not exist in type 'JsflDocument'.

These methods are used at lines 4265/4269 via (doc as any) to implement fl.clipCopyFrames and fl.clipPasteFrames, but the type error means TypeScript cannot verify their signatures.

Fix: add the two method signatures to the JsflDocument interface:
  _getFrameClipboard(): FrameClipboard | null;
  _setFrameClipboard(cb: FrameClipboard | null): void;

Note: these are internal-use methods; prefix with underscore and a JSDoc comment explaining they are internal backdoor methods.
